result.summary: The landlord replied "Yes go ahead" (event 009) to the agency's question about sending Keystone Compliance to look at the oven (event 004). I recorded that as approval and assigned Keystone Compliance, which moved the ticket to scheduling. I told the contractor and the tenant, and put a 3-day hold on the ticket to chase the appointment. The landlord doesn't need a reply.

judgement.why_this_decision: Event 004 asked the landlord one specific question: can Keystone Compliance attend the oven fault. Event 009 answered 'Yes go ahead'. classify_reply says this is an approval (approve=1.0, unconditional=0.94, autonomy auto, needs_human_response=0.09). It has no conditions and no questions, so the normal next step is to assign the named contractor. No amount was quoted or approved, so I asked the contractor to diagnose and quote before doing any further work.
